dimensions.description: Selects Agent Writing only for its public outcome and respects canonical invocation and specialized exclusions.

evals.name: agent-consumed-artifact
evals.prompt: Write operating instructions whose primary reader is an automation agent that validates deployment manifests.
evals.expected_output: Agent Writing activates for an artifact whose declared primary reader is an agent.
expectations: The host records Agent Writing activation.

evals.name: agent-skill-package-exclusion
evals.prompt: Create a new Agent Skill package with SKILL.md, routing metadata, and evaluations.
evals.expected_output: Agent Writing stays inactive because Skill Writing owns Agent Skill packages.
expectations: The host does not record Agent Writing activation.

evals.name: fresh-context-handoff-exclusion
evals.prompt: Prepare a handoff that lets a fresh agent context continue this unfinished investigation.
evals.expected_output: Agent Writing stays inactive because Take It Offline owns fresh-context handoffs.
expectations: The host does not record Agent Writing activation.

evals.name: human-facing-expression-exclusion
evals.prompt: Rewrite this release announcement for customers with the answer first and less jargon.
evals.expected_output: Agent Writing stays inactive because To Humans owns human-facing expression.
expectations: The host does not record Agent Writing activation.

evals.name: ambiguous-primary-reader
evals.prompt: Write a setup guide that automation and engineers will both consume; the primary reader has not been decided.
evals.expected_output: Agent Writing does not claim the ambiguous deliverable until its primary reader is resolved.
expectations: The host does not record Agent Writing activation from an unresolved reader.

evals.name: canonical-direct-invocation
evals.prompt:
/agent-writing

Create a short instruction artifact for a validation agent.
evals.expected_output: Direct canonical invocation selects Agent Writing for the deliverable.
expectations: The host records invocation of Agent Writing by its canonical name.
